ai_analysis.summary: A recruitment post seeking a Senior Data Engineer open to work in Germany or the UAE. It lists Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, PySpark, Spark, Azure Synapse, and SQL, promotes an attached PDF and WhatsApp channel, and recommends data-engineering accounts to follow. It briefly describes Lakehouse as combining data-lake flexibility with data-warehouse performance for real-time and batch workloads, and Medallion as organizing data into Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers for quality and traceability, but it does not substantively compare Lakehouse and Medallion.
